transcription.author: AI-assisted transcription from original answer key
transcription.notes: The original question and all Possible Answer attributes control this reference. Legacy fields were reused only where checked against the original text; omitted attributes and source distinctions were restored. No application run or extracted evidence was used to choose expected values.

contract_notes: Exactly all 60 original question IDs are retained. Unevaluable questions are reported separately, never silently zero or omitted from the manifest.
Scorable questions are provisional typed comparisons, not independently validated gold answers.
Null means no value is reported in the source, not a system abstention; abstention uses answer status unknown/unanswered.
Tables are unordered multisets unless ordinal fields give sequence. Repeated source rows remain distinct.
Timestamp fields preserve source meaning; explicit offsets override case timezone. Other local-time captions use America/New_York provisionally; ambiguities are marked unevaluable.
Default casefold_whitespace comparison ignores case and PDF whitespace, not arbitrary paraphrase. URL paths use exact or explicitly declared printed-prefix matching.
Sizes keep printed precision. File paths retain printed spelling except documented line-wrap/separator normalization.
Source excerpts and hashes permit transcription audit, not proof that the key's narrative interpretation is correct.
field_sources binds exact literal strings to source line ranges only. It does not certify that a literal belongs to the correct expected field or that derived values are correct.
